props.title: Postmortem: ledger connection pool exhausted during payout run
props.text: INC-2025-044, sev 2. Impact: payouts were delayed by three hours and some payment captures failed. Timeline: ledger-service v3.4.0 added a parallel payout journal writer. During the daily payout run it opened more connections than the database pool allowed, starving payments-api requests. Root cause: database connection pool exhaustion. Follow-up: load-test payout runs against the pool limit. Res…

props.name: Database connection pool exhaustion
props.description: More concurrent work than the connection pool allows, so requests queue or fail.

props.title: ledger-service connection pool exhausted during payout run
props.summary: ledger-service v3.4.0 added a parallel payout journal writer that opened more connections than the ledger-db pool allowed, starving payment captures. Raised the pool ceiling and capped writer concurrency.
props.symptom: payout run stalled; payment captures failing with pool timeout errors

nodes.label: Resolution
nodes.name: Raised pool ceiling and capped payout writer concurrency

props.summary: Raised pool ceiling and capped payout writer concurrency
props.steps: 1. Reduce payout writer concurrency to 4. 2. Raise the ledger-db connection pool limit. 3. Re-run the stalled payout batch.

props.excerpt: Resolution: raised the ledger connection pool ceiling and capped payout writer concurrency.
